error[ZBX-E0228]: --gpu found no GPU device to give
  while  looking for a GPU for --gpu all
  cause  no nvidia.com/gpu device in the CDI specs ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cdi,
         /var/run/cdi, /etc/cdi), and no render node (/dev/dri/renderD*) or
         /dev/kfd that you can open
  gpu    all
  fix    see what this host has, and the fix for each gap:   zbx doctor
  more   zbx explain E0228
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0228.html
